name: Cua Ca Mau
summary: Cua Cà Mau is the mangrove crab of the cape, sold as meat crab or roe crab. Meat crab is firm and sweet, and roe crab is full and rich.
origin: Đất Mũi and Cà Mau city. Phòng Văn hóa Thông tin huyện Ngọc Hiển and Vietnam Airlines both describe the meat crab and roe crab pair.
taste: Meat crab is firm and sweet. Roe crab is full and rich.
howToEat: Order it steamed, stir-fried with tamarind (rang me), or as lẩu cua, a crab hotpot.
Make it the main meal on the cape day or back in the city.
where: Đất Mũi and Cà Mau city.
seoDescription: Cua Cà Mau is mangrove crab: firm and sweet as meat crab, full and rich as roe crab. Order it steamed, rang me, or as a crab hotpot.
